subject: Body-Worn Camera Annual Surveillance Report
overview: The committee met to review the Medford Police Department's first annual surveillance report under the Community Control Over Public Surveillance (CCOPS) ordinance regarding the rollout of body-worn cameras. The committee voted to receive the report and place it on file.

items.title: Annual Surveillance Report Presentation (24-074)
items.summary: Police Chief Jack Buckley presented the first annual surveillance report on the department's December 2023 body-worn camera pilot, detailing camera usage, internal auditing, and the redaction process handled by designated officers. After extensive public testimony and council discussion concerning officer pre-statement video review policies and bulk data acquisition, the committee voted to receive the report and place it on file.
